bundle.built: esbuild 0.24, iife, minified; react/react-dom → window globals; next/link and the v2 flag shimmed

color.note: Light is the default (long-hour plant/ops readability); dark is opt-in via data-theme="dark". The two "Deep Violet Matte" themes are the source's flag-gated v2 finish (html data-ui="v2"), which re-tunes the same variable names. Purple is identity, not status: success, warning and danger stay the universal green, amber and red.

tokens.name: mn-purple-50
tokens.usage: Lightest violet wash: ghost-button hover, nav hover, the icon chip behind KPI and empty-state icons, and the selected-row ground. The v2 finish deepens it a hair.

tokens.name: mn-purple-100
tokens.usage: Brand ramp step 100. The "Nova" word in the on-dark logo lockup.

tokens.name: mn-purple-200
tokens.usage: Brand ramp step 200. Reserved for tints; no component reads it yet.

tokens.name: mn-purple-300
tokens.usage: Soft Lavender. The base focus ring, dark-theme info text, and the recommended tint for an active nav icon.

tokens.name: mn-purple-400
tokens.usage: Brand ramp step 400. Dark-theme primary hover.

tokens.name: mn-purple-500
tokens.usage: Electric Violet. Dark-theme primary and the end stop of mn-gradient.

tokens.name: mn-purple-600
tokens.usage: Primary Purple. Light-theme primary, info tone, and the start stop of mn-gradient.

tokens.name: mn-purple-700
tokens.usage: Light-theme primary hover.

tokens.name: mn-purple-800
tokens.usage: Brand ramp step 800. Reserved for deep accents; no component reads it yet.

tokens.name: mn-purple-900
tokens.usage: Brand ramp step 900, the deepest violet. Reserved.

tokens.name: mn-navy
tokens.usage: Deep Dark/Navy. Light-theme ink and the dark-theme card surface; the wordmark's "MIX".

tokens.name: mn-grey
tokens.usage: Neutral Grey. Subtle, non-text detail and the "RMC SOFTWARE" line of the wordmark; 3.2:1 on white, so never body text.

tokens.name: mn-bg
tokens.usage: Page and app-shell ground behind every card.

tokens.name: mn-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, topbar, inputs, dialogs, drawers: the working surface.

tokens.name: mn-surface-2
tokens.usage: Second-level surface: secondary-button hover, neutral badge ground, funnel tracks, v2 table headers, the list-cap strip.

tokens.name: mn-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, sidebar and topbar seams, skeleton fill. Decorative at ~1.3:1; never the only cue.

tokens.name: mn-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, search, secondary buttons, v2 table-header underline.

tokens.name: mn-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on mn-bg, mn-surface and mn-surface-2 (13.8:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: mn-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, table headers, subtitles, KPI labels, nav items at rest. On mn-surface and mn-bg in every theme (5.9:1 or better; AA).

tokens.name: mn-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary detail: nav-group headers (11px caps), help text, v2 table headers, chevrons, funnel captions. Light themes 3.0–3.4:1 on the surfaces, so it is non-text or large/uppercase-label only there (the source says so); dark themes 5.1:1+.

tokens.name: mn-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active nav pill, links, icon-chip ink, selected-row keyline. As text on mn-surface: 7.0:1 light, 3.6:1 dark (large/bold only there).

tokens.name: mn-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: mn-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an mn-primary fill (primary button, skip link, active nav). 7.0:1 light and v2 light, 4.5:1 v2 dark; the base dark theme's ink-on-violet is 4.0:1, short of AA for 14px labels (source pair, kept).

tokens.name: mn-focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring (outline, 2px offset) on every control. Base light: Soft Lavender is 2.6:1 on white, below the 3:1 floor (a known source pair, fixed in v2 by using the primary violet). Dark: 6.4:1. v2: 7.0:1 light, 3.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: mn-success
tokens.usage: Success tone: approved, delivered, paid, cleared. Text on mn-success-tint (4.6:1 light, 7.6:1 dark, 5.6:1 v2 light, 6.9:1 v2 dark) and on mn-surface (5.0:1+); the KPI severity rail and alert border.

tokens.name: mn-success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind mn-success text: success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: mn-warning
tokens.usage: Warning tone: on hold, credit hold, partially paid, low stock, unpaid, expired. Text on mn-warning-tint (4.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark, 6.3:1 v2 light) and on mn-surface (5.0:1+); the offline banner ink.

tokens.name: mn-warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind mn-warning text: warning badges, alerts, the offline banner.

tokens.name: mn-danger
tokens.usage: Danger tone: cancelled, rejected, overdue, negative stock, suspended, bounced. Text on mn-danger-tint (5.3:1 light, 5.9:1 dark) and on mn-surface (6.4:1+); the danger button fill, error-state border, required-field asterisk. White on this fill is 6.5:1 in the light themes but 2.8:1 in both dark themes (source pair, kept).

tokens.name: mn-danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind mn-danger text: danger badges, alerts, the error state.

tokens.name: mn-info
tokens.usage: Info / processing tone: submitted, pending, batching, in transit, dispatched, invoiced. Violet, so it reads as brand-not-status. Text on mn-info-tint (6.0:1 or better everywhere).

tokens.name: mn-info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind mn-info text: info and processing badges and alerts.

tokens.name: mn-surface-command
tokens.usage: Ground of the command surfaces (CommandBar, Surface variant="command"). Base themes alias mn-surface; v2 adds a hair of cool tint.

tokens.name: mn-border-command
tokens.usage: Border of the command surfaces; v2 promotes it to the strong hairline.

tokens.name: mn-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of an interactive row (.mn-row).

tokens.name: mn-selected
tokens.usage: Selected-row and selected-toolbar ground. In v2 the source mixes 8% (light) / 20% (dark) of mn-primary into mn-surface with color-mix(), which this file cannot hold; bundle.css carries those two values.

tokens.name: mn-selected-border
tokens.usage: Keyline of a selected row (2px inset) and the selected toolbar's border. v2 uses a color-mix() of mn-primary into mn-border-strong, carried by bundle.css.

tokens.name: mn-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind drawers, dialogs and the mobile sidebar.

tokens.name: mn-glass
tokens.usage: Near-opaque glass ground reserved for command surfaces (never tables or forms). Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-glass-border
tokens.usage: Hairline on a glass surface. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-fg
tokens.usage: Text on the deep-violet sidebar rail (14.5:1 on the rail's mid stop #1d1540); the hovered nav label and active icon. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-muted
tokens.usage: Nav items at rest on the rail (8.1:1 light). Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-title
tokens.usage: Nav-group headers on the rail (11px caps, 5.0:1 light). Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-icon
tokens.usage: Nav icons at rest on the rail. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-active
tokens.usage: Active nav pill ground on the rail. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of a nav item or group header on the rail. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-rail-border
tokens.usage: The rail's right-hand seam. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-age-current
tokens.usage: Receivables ageing: the "current" bucket. A donut stroke and its legend swatch (never text). Every segment is labelled; colour never carries the meaning alone. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-age-ageing
tokens.usage: Receivables ageing: the "ageing" bucket (stroke + swatch only). Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-age-overdue
tokens.usage: Receivables ageing: the "overdue" bucket (stroke + swatch only). Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-donut-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track behind the ageing donut. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-gauge-a
tokens.usage: Start stop of the funnel bar and collections gauge gradient. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: mn-gauge-b
tokens.usage: End stop of the funnel bar and collections gauge gradient. Defined only under data-ui="v2" in the source; the Light/Dark columns repeat the v2 values because the base UI never reads it.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Legacy Phase-1 alias read by the body rule and older screens; always equals mn-bg.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Legacy Phase-1 alias; always equals mn-surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Legacy Phase-1 alias read by the body rule; always equals mn-text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Legacy Phase-1 alias; always equals mn-muted.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Legacy Phase-1 alias; always equals mn-primary.

tokens.name: brand-contrast
tokens.usage: Legacy Phase-1 alias; always equals mn-on-primary.

families.body: "Inter", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk at 600–700 for every heading, title and big number (Outfit under the v2 finish). h1–h3 carry letter-spacing -0.01em; the app body enables tabular figures ('tnum') so rupee and quantity columns align.

styles.name: lp-title
styles.sample: Run the plant from one screen
styles.usage: Public landing headline; clamps down to 36px on phones.

styles.name: lp-h2
styles.usage: Landing section heading; clamps down to 26px.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: KPI tile value (v2; clamps to 22px on narrow phones). Tabular figures.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page h1 inside the v2 shell (26px in the earlier v2 pass; the base shell leaves h1 at the browser default with -0.01em).

styles.name: stat-value-legacy
styles.usage: KPI tile value in the base (flag-off) StatCard; also the collections gauge figure.

styles.name: op-value
styles.usage: Operations-grid tile value (v2 dashboard). Tabular figures.

styles.name: cmdbar-title
styles.usage: CommandBar title (rendered as h1). Also the landing capability-card title.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card header title (v2; the base Card uses 15px), drawer and dialog titles, empty-state titles, the topbar page label.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: In-card section heading (h2) and the operations-grid header.

styles.name: funnel-value
styles.usage: Funnel bar figure and legend amounts (600). Tabular figures.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter for every label, control and data cell, with Noto Sans Devanagari and Noto Sans Tamil falling in only for glyphs Inter lacks, so Indian-language customer and site names render with real glyphs. 14px is the working size; uppercase labels are tracked.

styles.name: lp-lede
styles.sample: Orders, batching, dispatch, billing and collections in one system.
styles.usage: Landing lede under the headline; clamps down to 16px.

styles.name: lp-body
styles.sample: Every challan carries its batch ticket and weighbridge slip.
styles.usage: Landing capability-card body copy.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Table cells, inputs, nav items, the skip link, the search field: the app's working size.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label (md). Minimum height 40px, padding 10px 16px.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Small button label. Minimum height 32px, padding 6px 11px.

styles.name: alert-body
styles.sample: Orders ORD-2041, ORD-2044 exceed their customer credit limit.
styles.usage: AlertSurface body; its title is the same size at 600. v2 nav labels are also 13.5px at 500.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field label in mn-muted; a required mark in mn-danger follows it.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Command-bar subtitle, toolbar count, empty-state description, error-state text, list-cap notice, offline banner (500).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Funnel labels, chart legends, operations-grid captions, gallery notes.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge text on its tone tint; padding 3px 9px.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Leave blank to keep the current value.
styles.usage: Field help (mn-subtle) and error (mn-danger) text; the base table header uses 12px at 600 in uppercase with 0.02em tracking.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: v2 table header in mn-subtle, uppercase (the base header is 12px / 0.02em in mn-muted).

styles.name: stat-label
styles.usage: KPI tile label, uppercase, mn-muted (base tracking 0.03em).

styles.name: nav-group
styles.usage: Collapsible sidebar group header, uppercase, mn-subtle (mn-rail-title on the v2 rail).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Landing hero eyebrow, uppercase; the UI-kit page uses 11.5px at 0.14em.

spacing.note: An 8-step 4px scale, introduced with the v2 finish.

tokens.name: mn-space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: badge icon gap (5px in the source), nav-item vertical gap (2px). The scale exists only under data-ui="v2" in the source (components migrate onto it incrementally); the base kit uses the literal pixel values named here.

tokens.name: mn-space-2
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, toolbar action gap, badge row gap, filter-bar gaps (8–10px).

tokens.name: mn-space-3
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, drawer/dialog header gap, summary-strip gap, input horizontal padding, topbar gap.

tokens.name: mn-space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, legacy card padding, Surface padded, the dialog scrim inset, drawer head/foot padding.

tokens.name: mn-space-5
tokens.usage: Legacy confirm-dialog padding, v2 card-head horizontal padding.

tokens.name: mn-space-6
tokens.usage: v2 main-content padding (24px 28px), landing-page gutter.

tokens.name: mn-space-7
tokens.usage: Skip-link offset scale; landing CTA spacing.

tokens.name: mn-space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and permission-denied vertical padding; the minimum button height.

radius.note: Three steps plus a pill; the v2 finish rounds each step up by 3–6px.

tokens.name: mn-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks, search clear button, landing nav links, the login lockup focus outline.

tokens.name: mn-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, toolbar, filter bar, alerts, interactive rows, error state, legacy KPI icon chip, skip link.

tokens.name: mn-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, surfaces, command bar, dialog, empty-state icon chip, confirm dialog, the logo mark (rx 11 on 40).

tokens.name: mn-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and the offline banner.

tokens.name: mn-radius-sm-v2
tokens.usage: What mn-radius-sm becomes under the v2 finish (bundle.css remaps it for the v2 themes).

tokens.name: mn-radius-md-v2
tokens.usage: What mn-radius-md becomes under the v2 finish. Nav pills in v2 use 11–12px; the KPI icon chip 12px; the segmented control 10px outer / 7px inner.

tokens.name: mn-radius-lg-v2
tokens.usage: What mn-radius-lg becomes under the v2 finish: cards, surfaces, command/filter/tool bars.

shadow.note: Matte, low-reflection, multi-layer. Never a shadow where a hairline will do: tables and forms take borders, cards and floating surfaces take shadows.

tokens.name: mn-shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card elevation (.mn-card, v2 .mn-surface). The base dark theme keeps the light values.

tokens.name: mn-shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating things: drawer, dialog, offline banner, skip link, the mobile sidebar, a hovered v2 card or KPI tile.

tokens.name: mn-shadow-1
tokens.usage: v2 only: the lightest matte lift (secondary button, toolbar, filter bar, command bar, operations tile). Base columns repeat the v2 values.

tokens.name: mn-shadow-2
tokens.usage: v2 only: a hovered operations tile. Base columns repeat the v2 values.

tokens.name: mn-glow-primary
tokens.usage: v2 only: the selective violet glow under the primary button and nothing else. Base columns repeat the v2 values.

tokens.name: mn-elev-command
tokens.usage: Command-surface lift (CommandBar, Surface raised/command, the funnel tiles). v2 aliases mn-shadow-1.

duration.note: Restrained motion; every duration collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: mn-dur-micro
tokens.usage: Button colour/shadow/press transitions, table-row hover. Collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: mn-dur-std
tokens.usage: Card hover lift, scrim fade-in, dialog pop-in, offline-banner pop-in. Base rules fall back to 200ms when the token is absent.

tokens.name: mn-dur-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer slide-in from the right.

tokens.name: mn-ease
tokens.usage: The one easing curve for every transition and keyframe; base rules fall back to ease.
